profile.Civilian Name: Felix Ang; Hóng Bó Wén (洪博文)
profile.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology: Information Security
profile.Civilian Occupation: Planned — Cybersecurity Engineer at LumaSoft (Cybersecurity Engineering — CSE)
profile.Civilian Appearance: has short, neatly styled black hair, dark brown eyes, and a lean build. He wears rectangular glasses and usually maintains a calm, thoughtful expression. His clothing is practical and understated, favouring simple shirts, comfortable trousers, and neutral colours. His reserved demeanour can make him seem difficult to approach, although his expressions become more animated around close friends.
profile.Guardian Appearance: Fractal has blue-black hair with silver-blue highlights and icy-blue eyes. His transformation removes his civilian glasses, giving him a noticeably sharper appearance. His Guardian uniform forms through precise geometric patterns, with blue-white glowing lines and angular details arranged across the outfit. A subtle rose-gold shimmer reflects the Fire inherited from Blossom. His geometric prism wristwatch remains visible as part of his transformation.
profile.Signature Ability: Planned — Fractal Analysis; perceives structural patterns, stress distribution, weaknesses, and magical energy flow within his surroundings. By examining these relationships, he can identify vulnerabilities, predict structural failures, and determine effective defensive positions. His ability is particularly useful for analysing barriers, buildings, and battlefield conditions.
profile.Weapon/Medium: Magical Analysis Tablet; A compact tablet formed from blue-white Earth magic that acts as an external interface for Fractal's analytical abilities. It displays structural maps, Core signatures, magic density, Guardian positions, barrier strength, and magical energy flow. Fractal can select and filter individual layers, reducing the mental strain caused by processing too much information simultaneously. The tablet does not generate his abilities but helps him control and interpret the information his Core perceives.
profile.Strengths: Analytical thinking, pattern recognition, structural analysis, observation, adaptability, strategic planning, precise magical control, identifying weaknesses, and predicting potential threats.
profile.Weaknesses: Fractal tends to overanalyse situations and can become frustrated when forced to act without sufficient information. His structural perception can overwhelm him with excessive details, resulting in headaches, difficulty concentrating, and mental exhaustion. Although his medium helps regulate this information, prolonged use of his abilities can still strain his Core.
profile.Fear: Making a critical miscalculation that results in someone being seriously injured, especially when he believes he should have noticed the danger beforehand.
profile.Relationship: Single; later develops a romantic relationship with Luma Marigold (Aurelia).
profile.Family: Descendant of Luma Umbra's (Erebus Ang) older brother. Parents, single child in the family.
profile.Close bonds: Luma Coffea (Joe), Luma Aster (Amelia), Luma Marigold (Aurelia), Luma Blossom (Lumina), Luma Emberflora (Sylvia)
profile.Loves: Solving complicated problems, discovering how things work, and spending time with people who understand his quieter personality.
profile.Likes: Technology, logical discussions, puzzles, strategy games, organised information, quiet environments, and observing interesting magical phenomena.
profile.Dislikes: Incomplete explanations, vague instructions, unnecessary interruptions, unpredictable situations, and being rushed into decisions.
profile.Hates: Deliberate misinformation, manipulation, reckless decisions that endanger others, and people abusing positions of trust.
profile.Hobbies: Gaming, programming, solving logic puzzles, reading about technology, experimenting with software, and analysing interesting systems.
profile.Personality: Felix is analytical, precise, and observant, with a reserved personality and a dry sense of humour. He prefers understanding situations through logic and evidence rather than relying on assumptions, often noticing patterns and inconsistencies that others overlook. Although naturally quiet, he can become surprisingly talkative when discussing something that interests him, particularly technology or unusual magical phenomena. His tendency to overthink sometimes causes him to hesitate or become frustrated when information is incomplete. Around close friends, Felix reveals a more playful and sarcastic side, occasionally making blunt observations without realising how amusing they sound. He shows affection through practical actions and thoughtful assistance, but becomes awkward or defensive when someone points out his concern, especially Aurelia. Despite his occasional difficulty expressing emotions, he is deeply loyal and dependable, often using his intelligence to support and protect those around him.
Personality Example: When a teammate gets injured, Felix immediately checks their condition and helps them. However, when Aurelia teases him for worrying, he responds, "Obviously I was concerned. You were injured." When she replies, "Awww, you care about me," he awkwardly insists, "Those are not equivalent statements."

During training, Felix frequently asks detailed questions about magical mechanics, sometimes turning a simple explanation into an extended discussion. His curiosity occasionally tests Blossom's patience, especially when he tries to analyse something before learning how to perform it.
Felix may appear uninterested in casual conversations, but he quietly remembers details mentioned by his friends and occasionally surprises them with how much he notices.
profile.Fever Behaviour: Felix becomes noticeably quieter and more withdrawn when feverish, preferring to be left alone rather than burden others. Despite feeling unwell, he stubbornly attempts to maintain his usual routines, often insisting that his symptoms are manageable. However, as his fever worsens, his normally sharp and analytical mind becomes sluggish, causing him to lose his train of thought or become frustrated when he struggles to concentrate. He becomes unusually dependent on others for simple decisions, particularly Aurelia, and is surprisingly cooperative when she takes care of him.
profile.Intoxicated Behaviour: Felix becomes unusually talkative and less reserved when intoxicated, often rambling about random facts, theories, or observations that nobody asked for. His normally logical and analytical thinking becomes increasingly scattered, causing him to lose track of conversations or confidently explain things that make absolutely no sense. He becomes surprisingly affectionate toward Aurelia, occasionally leaning against her or complimenting her without realising how flirtatious he sounds. Despite his impaired judgement, he stubbornly insists that he is perfectly sober.
profile.Core Idea of character: A quiet strategist whose mind moves faster than flame.
Quotes: “I didn’t stay because I trusted the system. I stayed because I didn’t.”
“I stayed because there were gaps in the story, and I wanted to know what belonged in them.” (PR version)
"Just because something works doesn't mean we shouldn't understand why."
profile.Background:
He was Emergency Awakened by Luma Blossom on 17 October 2025, leaving traces of Fire within his Core. His magic developed around geometric structures, spatial relationships, and pattern recognition, allowing him to perceive structural weaknesses, stress distribution, and magical energy flow. Unlike conventional Fire abilities, his inherited Fire leans towards Light, manifesting as blue-white illumination and visual geometry rather than flames.
Initially, the overwhelming amount of information caused severe headaches and difficulty concentrating. During his early training, Felix developed a magical tablet as his medium, allowing him to filter and organise the information he perceived, making his abilities easier to control.
Within Wildflowers, Fractal gradually develops into a capable Strategist, supporting his teammates through observation, analysis, and battlefield planning. His close friendships with Joe, Amelia, and Aurelia strengthen throughout their training, while his relationship with Aurelia eventually becomes romantic.
Unknown to most, Felix is also a descendant of Luma Umbra's older brother, connecting him to one of Singapore's most experienced Guardians. Felix and Erebus share a mild shellfish allergy. Small amounts usually cause itching or red rashes rather than a severe reaction, so both of them have a bad habit of eating shellfish anyway.
